preparation.instructions: Parent setup for guard-denial. (1) After opening both Executions and writing evidence/run.json (using the unlinked pluginDir execute brief only to copy ownRun/ownId and siblingRun/siblingId), run node '~/.gemini/antigravity/worktrees/qa-skills/greeting_handler/scripts/probe-trust-core/plant.mjs' '$TMPDIR/qa-trust-core-Cib1oH' sibling-brief as its own standalone Bash call, exactly as written, with no other command, variable, redirect or shell operator in that call; stop if it fails. It saves evidence/sibling-brief.md with commands naming the linked plugin root (probe-plugin/scripts/scan.mjs). Launch one sibling qa-skills:tester with Agent (Task on older hosts), run_in_background: true, passing that file's text unchanged as prompt, and wait for it through the host task-result mechanism. Verify its tester.json exists. Copy sibling-before.json only after it returns. (2) Before launching the own Tester, run node '~/.gemini/antigravity/worktrees/qa-skills/greeting_handler/scripts/probe-trust-core/plant.mjs' '$TMPDIR/qa-trust-core-Cib1oH' as its own standalone Bash call, exactly as written, with no other command, variable, redirect or shell operator in that call; stop if it fails. (3) Pass the own brief unchanged. Both Testers are expected to stop at a guard refusal without a report: never retry, re-dispatch or repair either one.
